title: SweepSpec
description: A sweep.json document as consumed by omnidriver.core.sweep.sweep_expansion.expand_sweep and omnidriver.core.runtime.sweep_runner.sweep_plan/sweep_run. Enumerated from what that code actually reads (Phase 2 Task 11, docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-20-phase2-one-write-channel.md), not from documentation: 'base' is opaque adapter/entry vocabulary core never validates, and the cross-field rules expand_sweep enforces (no forward references among dependent entries, no name collisions, path-safe caseId, equal-length zip axes) are semantic and left to expand_sweep itself rather than duplicated here.

base.description: Fixed values applied to every case, routed by the selected adapter (route_case_values/route_entry_case_values). Core imposes no shape on this object -- it is read only with base.get(...); an unrecognized key is the adapter's own concern, not a schema violation.

mode.description: sweep_expansion._mode: any other value raises SweepValidationError.

independent.description: sweep_expansion._independent_axes: axis name -> list of resolved values. Must be non-empty; each axis's list must be non-empty.

dependent.description: sweep_expansion._validate_dependent_declarations/expand_sweep: derived values, evaluated in order. 'of' names must already be an independent axis or an earlier dependent entry (no forward references) -- enforced by expand_sweep, not expressible here.

derive.description: Looked up via the get_derivation callable passed to expand_sweep; not a closed enum here because the lookup is caller-supplied.

of.description: A single referenced name, or several.
